cues.text: Let's manage the users of your school.
Open Settings in the sidebar and click the Users tab. It lists every user of your school.
Press Add User to open the form.
Enter the name, a username, an email and a password, then choose the role. The list only offers roles you are allowed to create.
Press Create User. A green message confirms it, and the user can log in straight away.
Search by name, username or email, or filter by role, to find the user in the list.
Click Edit to change the name, email, role or phone. The username cannot be changed.
If someone forgets their password, click Reset Password. Set a new password now, or email them a reset link when they have an email address.
Click Deactivate, and the user can no longer log in.
Click Activate to give the access back.
